key_idea: The hole must be on a spot that is inside every one of the 4 sheets.
steps: Check each spot against each sheet, one sheet at a time.
A is only on the pink sheet. E is only on the green sheet.
B is above the top edge of the green sheet. C is below the pink sheet.
D is inside all 4 sheets, so a hole there goes through every sheet.

choice_feedback.A: This spot is only on the pink sheet.
choice_feedback.B: This spot is above the green sheet, so the hole would miss it.
choice_feedback.C: This spot is below the pink sheet, so the hole would miss it.
choice_feedback.E: This spot is only on the green sheet.
